question: The successive discounts of 28%, 20% and 10% are equivalent to a single discount of:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net discount for **28%** and **20%** = 28 + 20 − (28 × 20) ÷ 100 = 48 − 5.6 = **42.4%**.

Net discount for **42.4%** and **10%** = 42.4 + 10 − (42.4 × 10) ÷ 100.

⇒ 52.4 − 4.24 = **48.16%**.

**∴ The correct answer is 48.16%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Successive discounts of **28%**, **20%**, and **10%**.

Formula: **SP = MP × (100 − d₁)% × (100 − d₂)% × (100 − d₃)%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa0e6f55d09a9bd018108aaf7ebc1ae233b8ffe5715f3fc4f07528ea040e630c.png] 

Let the **Marked Price (MP)** be 100.

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = 100 × (72/100) × (80/100) × (90/100)

⇒ SP = 100 × 0.72 × 0.8 × 0.9 = **51.84**.

⇒ Single Equivalent Discount = MP − SP = 100 − 51.84 = **48.16%**.

**∴ The correct answer is 48.16%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

For two successive discounts a% and b%, the single equivalent discount is (a + b − ab/100)%.

Marked Price & Selling Price

Discount is always calculated on the **Marked Price (MP)**. SP = MP − Discount.</p
